title: Learning-Augmented Approximation for Unrelated-Machines Makespan Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2606.13133v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recently, Antoniadis et al. (ICLR 2025) proposed a framework for incorporating predictions to approximate NP-hard selection problems. Despite its simplicity, this approach tightly matches theoretical lower bounds, making its generalization highly compelling. We address an open question raised in the work of Antoniadis et al., concerning the extension of this approach to other important problems outside the class of selection problems, such as scheduling. We develop a learning-augmented algorithm for the makespan minimization problem on unrelated machines, denoted by $R\|C_{\max}$. By using predictions of heavy job assignments, we achieve a polynomial-time $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation for accurate predictions that smoothly degrades to a worst-case 2-approximation as the error increases. We conclude our work with an empirical analysis of our method.

translated_title: 面向不相关机型完工时间调度的学习增强近似算法
translated_abstract: 最近，Antoniadis等人（ICLR 2025）提出了一个将预测融入NP难选择问题近似的框架。尽管该方法非常简单，却能紧致地匹配理论下界，使其推广极具吸引力。我们着手解决Antoniadis等人在其工作中提出的一个开放性问题，即如何将该方法扩展到选择问题类别之外的其他重要问题，例如调度问题。我们为不相关机器上的完工时间最小化问题（记为 $R\|C_{\max}$）开发了一种学习增强算法。通过使用重任务分配的预测，我们在预测准确时实现了多项式时间的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似，并随着误差的增大平滑地退化为最坏情况下的2-近似。最后，我们对所提方法进行了实证分析。
tldr: 本文回应了Antoniadis等人提出的开放性问题，将学习增强近似框架从选择问题推广到调度领域，针对不相关机器完工时间最小化问题提出了利用重任务分配预测的算法，在预测准确时达到(1+ε)-近似，并随误差增大平滑退化为最坏情况2-近似。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves an open question by extending a learning-augmented approximation framework beyond selection problems, proposing an algorithm for unrelated-machines makespan minimization that achieves (1+ε)-approximation with accurate predictions and smoothly degrades to a worst-case 2-approximation as prediction error grows.
